result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I raised no new findings, and I had no open findings to verify, so the verifications file holds an empty list.

**Identity.** HEAD was one commit past the source commit `33db1a46`. That commit adds only the assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`, which the candidate excludes, so the product tree is identical. The recomputed candidate ID matches `sha256:c45d73b8…` over 2769 files, both in the repository and in a clean full clone. It matched again at the end, after the runner auto-committed the domain reviewer's record during my run. I did not open that record.

**The round-10 repair (BE-Z15, the issuer-tagged tokens):**
- **The tag:** a truncated keyed hash under a random 32-byte key per rule-version row, checked in constant time. It reveals nothing beyond the row version, which the API already serves.
- **The key:** never served, audited, logged, copied into a new version or put in a payload; I checked every serializer, insert, trigger and export path. The database refuses any change to it, from either role. The demo checksum is unaffected, because the demo seed creates no rule versions.
- **Saves:** the version check runs under a row lock before tokens are resolved. Malformed tokens, concurrent identical saves, and grants given or revoked between read and save neither lose nor misplace a hidden value. My probe covered all of this (8/8 pass), as did a real-browser test of the editor in English and Arabic (2/2 pass).

**Checks run:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Typecheck, build, lint, format, OpenAPI lint, no-CDN | all exit 0; OpenAPI lint counts 932 operations |
| `pnpm test`, Node 24 | exit 0: 2902 + 2105 + 259 passed, 2 skipped by design |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 (22.22.0) | final unmodified run exit 0; see below |
| Integration, LANG unset | 439 files: 4354 passed, 1 skip and 1 todo (both explained) |
| Integration, LANG=C.UTF-8 | same result |
| End-to-end specs the register defers (A12, A13, A14, A17, A21, A22) | 36/36 pass in English and Arabic |
| Historical validation DG5–DG1, DG6 register | all exit 0 |

**Disclosed in the record:**
- **Node 22 runs:** two runs exited 1 with every test passing. The test runner's internal messaging timed out while the shared host was overloaded. Both a two-worker re-run and the unmodified re-run then passed cleanly.
- **Scratch-space and time limits:** to avoid running out of scratch space, I ran integration shards one at a time. One background job hit the 2-hour limit while doing an extra, unneeded shard re-run; its partial log shows no failures. I cleaned up its leftover database directory.
- **Assignment inconsistencies:** it says `round: 7`; I used 11, matching the directory and my round-10 record. Its P6 diff end point (`70f05ed`) is the round-7 freeze commit, its migration ranges stop at 0123/0125 while 0127 exists, and it names Node 22.22.2 where the machine has 22.22.0.
- **Residuals:** the capacity targets (REQ-S20-029/030) are accepted as environmental residuals. They were measured on one sandbox host on an earlier tree, and I did not re-run the full-dataset proofs. The OIDC, external-system and live-CI residuals are accepted on their offline surfaces.

**D-229 and D-228 (4):** I accept both rulings. No served column, response, notification channel or write path names a hidden record. No sequence of edits, saves or grant changes loses or misplaces a hidden value. The cross-organization case of the route sweep passes in both locales.

**One observation (not a finding):** a dry run on a sample event the writer chooses tells them whether a record id they already hold is the hidden value in a condition. Guessing such an id is infeasible, so this only confirms an id the writer already has, which is the exposure D-223 accepted. It predates this repair.

The record validates against the review schema with Ajv, and every cited evidence path exists.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG6/round-11/code-security-reviewer.json`
- `reviews/DG6/round-11/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`
- `test-evidence/DG6/code-security/round-11/` (scripts, probes and logs)
